subject: extracting the common coordinates from two methylbase objects prior to diffmeth

messages.author: b5b1db21b60ddd4a
messages.subject: extracting the common coordinates from two methylbase objects prior to diffmeth
parts:
Hi,

 

I have read in 4 different files and made two different methylRawList objects:

myobj1=read(file.list1,sample.id=list("A1","S1"),assembly="hg19",header=TRUE,sep=" ",treatment=c(0,1))

myobj2=read(file.list2,sample.id=list("A2","S2"),assembly="hg19",header=TRUE,sep=" ",treatment=c(0,1))

Whereby A1 and S1 represent the control  and test sample using technique1.

And A2 and S2 are the same individuals using technique2.

 

Then, the data were filtered :

filtered.myobj1=filterByCoverage(myobj1,lo.count=10,lo.perc=NULL,hi.count=NULL,hi.perc=99.9)

filtered.myobj2=filterByCoverage(myobj2,lo.count=10,lo.perc=NULL,hi.count=NULL,hi.perc=99.9)

 

Then the control and test were united for common CGs:

meth1=unite(filtered.myobj1, destrand=FALSE)

meth2=unite(filtered.myobj2, destrand=FALSE)

 

Next, I want to do calculateDiffMeth for meth1 and meth2 but my issue is that the CGs that will go into the calculateDiffMeth are not identical between meth1 and meth2.

I need the identical CGs as input as ultimately I want to know what is differentially methylated between treatment and control for each technique and I want to compare how well the techniques will overlap and the fairest way is to have identical CG coordinates for each technique (e.g. meth1 and meth2) as inputs for the diffmeth calculation.

 

Can you advise on how to extract the common lines between meth1 and meth2 methylBase objects as input that remains as a correctly formatted methylBase object for input for calculateDiffMeth?

 

I assume I have to use getData to make a data frame, and somehow filter the files so that they have the same coordinates, then convert the data frame back into a methylBase object.

 

How can I do that?

 

Michelle

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] extracting the common coordinates from two methylbase objects prior to diffmeth
parts:
You can make sure meth1 and meth2 have common CpGs the following way( there are other ways as well):
meth1= meth1[ paste(meth1$chr, meth1$start)   %in%  paste(meth2$chr,meth2$start)  ,]
meth2= meth2[ paste(meth2$chr, meth2$start)   %in%  paste(meth1$chr,meth1$start)  ,]

paste() makes a vector of strings that contain chr and start location. You basically look if the location string for meth1 is included in meth2 and vice versa.

Best,
Altuna

messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] extracting the common coordinates from two methylbase objects prior to diffmeth
parts:
In general, if you're confident in your data handling, you can also create methylDiff objects with the following call, starting with an input data frame 'x' with the columns c('chr','start','end','strand','pvalue','qvalue','meth.diff'):

output=new("methylDiff",x,
     sample.ids=sample.ids,
       assembly=assembly,
     context=context,
        treatment=treatment,
destranded=destranded,
     resolution=resolution)

Again only use this if you'e confident in your handling, because it won't throw an error if you have missing/misordered columns, and you won't be able to do anything downstream.
